BTC/USD

Bitcoin price trades at $64,830 on Thursday, holding above the 50-day Exponential Moving Average (EMA) at $64,670 but still capped well below the 100-day EMA at $67,049 and the 200-day EMA at $72,564. [...] Bitcoin (BTC) is a decentralized peer-to-peer digital currency originally designed to facilitate digital payments across the globe. Launched by anonymous figure Satoshi Nakamoto in 2009, Bitcoin's success largely depended on how it facilitated recorded ownership and facilitated the transfer of assets through a distributed ledger known as blockchain technology. [...] Bitcoin futures are contracts that enable traders to speculate on the price of Bitcoin without owning the underlying asset. Similar to other futures products, these contracts obligate investors to buy or sell Bitcoin for a predetermined price at a specific date.

Our real-time BTC to USD price update shows the current Bitcoin price as $62,997.20 USD.
   Our most recent Bitcoin price forecast indicates that its value will increase by 9.44% and reach $69,014.85 by August 19, 2026.
   Our technical indicators signal about the bearish Bullish 7% market sentiment on Bitcoin, while the Fear & Greed Index is displaying a score of 34 (Fear).
   Over the last 30 days, Bitcoin has had 14/30 (47%) green days and 1.27% price volatility.

Daily and weekly Bitcoin price predictions use different historical data windows depending on the forecast horizon. Daily forecasts analyze BTC/USD price data from the previous 7 days, while weekly forecasts use data from the previous 4 weeks. The models combine this data with technical indicators, statistical forecasting models, historical price patterns, and trend analysis to estimate the most probable price scenarios.
